Conversion of the Gas Power slot-reservation book into firm orders and then into shipped revenue at guided margins - now 116GW under contract ("Backlog grew from 44 to 53 gigawatts, and SRAs increased from 56 to 63 gigawatts") against a 20GW annualized output rate starting 3Q26; the checkable near-term milestone management itself set is the 2H26 crossover where backlog GW exceeds SRA GW ("we expect to convert many of these SRAs into orders, driving continued growth in our backlog while achieving an important inflection point with gigawatts and backlog greater than SRAs").
